name: Delaware Watershed Conservation Fund
summary: NFWF grants, funded mainly by the US Fish and Wildlife Service, for habitat restoration, water quality and water management projects on public and private land in the Delaware River watershed.

geography.label: Delaware River watershed (NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD)

steps: Virtual proposal lab for requests of $1M or more

eligibility.rule: Address at least one Delaware River Basin Restoration Program Framework Strategic Program Area
Include at least one Cross-Program Activity from the Framework
Keep the project entirely within the Delaware River watershed
Have a project start date after July 1, 2026
Be ready within six months of award and finish within three years
Not be an unincorporated individual, business, or international organization

documents: Statement of Litigation, unless a federal, state, or local government applicant
Board of Trustees or Directors list, or statement that none exists
GAAP audited financial statements, unless current valid information is already on file
IRS Form 990, unless current valid information is already on file
Single Audit, unless current valid information is already on file

status.quote: Delaware Watershed Conservation Fund 2026 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include: non-profit 501(c) organizations; federal, state, interstate, local and municipal governments, Tribal governments and organizations, and educational institutions.

geography.quote: Projects must be implemented entirely within the Delaware River watershed

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through NFWF's Easygrants system

amount.quote: The DWCF will award grants ranging from $75,000 to no more than $1,500,000 in 2026.

co_finance_required.quote: Matching contributions are encouraged but not required for this funding opportunity.

consortium_required.quote: The DWCF will fund both individual organizations and local/regional collaboratives.

effort.quote: In 2026, applicants requesting $1M or more are required to meet with the DWCF team via a virtual proposal lab before submitting an application.
Full Proposal Due Date: Thursday, March 26th, 2026, by 11:59 PM EST

eligibility.quote: Address one or more Delaware River Basin Restoration Program Framework Strategic Program Areas (listed above).
Incorporate one or more Cross-Program Activities outlined in the Framework.
Projects must be implemented entirely within the Delaware River watershed, which includes portions of New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and a small portion of Maryland.
Projects must have a start date after July 1, 2026.
Projects must be ready to begin within six months of the grant award and be completed within a three-year period of performance.
Ineligible applicants include: unincorporated individuals, businesses, and international organizations.

documents.quote: Full Proposal Narrative: The most important upload is your actual full proposal narrative.

Statement of Litigation Yes Template provided in Easygrants online application "Uploads" section. Federal, state, and local government applicants are not required to complete this section. Board of Trustees or Directors Yes Provide a list of members. If your organization is not a nonprofit and does not have a Board, upload a document stating that none exists. GAAP Audited Financial Statements* Yes

IRS Form 990* Yes Please refer to the Required Financial Documents and FAQs webpage for details on all financial information required for submission. Single Audit* Yes Please refer to the Required Financial Documents and FAQs webpage for details on all financial information required for submission. Applicant Controls Questionnaire Yes
